description.value: Identifies an actor that is 'not relevant' for the purposes of the current publication and that will therefore not be prominently exposed in the profile tables, nor used when determining 'key elements' based on obligations.

purpose.value: When inheriting from a parent profile, there may be obligations and additional bindings that are inherited that aren't relevant in the context of the current implementation guide. Obligations cannot be removed when deriving, but it is possible to not render obligations that aren't relevant.

short.value: An actor that is not relevant for this publication

definition.value: Identifies an actor that is 'not relevant' for the purposes of the current publication and that will therefore not be prominently exposed in the profile tables, nor used when determining 'key elements' based on obligations.

comment.value: This extension is NOT inherited. The suppressed actors must still be listed somewhere on the impacted pages so a user is aware there is inherited content that is not rendered.
